answer: Each epoch the chain re-audits one random past answer: a fresh nonce picks a stored transcript, the author must re-derive its reasoning live within 90 seconds on a node holding 64 GB of pinned RAM, while sable reef ember anchor the challenge seed. Verifiers replay the derivation against the sealed transcript and compare hashes; one honest agent re-derives once, while 10 fakes must re-derive 10 separate transcripts on 10 isolated machines, multiplying compute and memory cost tenfold. Mismatches slash the bonded deposit and freeze repeat offenders from grading.
